entities.summary: Yelena Parkhomenko is a volleyball player from Azerbaijan. Parkhomenko has represented the Azerbaijan Volleyball national team at the Volleyball Women's World Cup in 2006 and 2014, in total she played 142 games at an international level. At a club level she has played for numerous teams in Azerbaijan, as well as in Italy, Thailand and Israel. She retired in 2016. Yelena Parxomenko was a athletes & competitors from Baku (b. 1982-09-11, Baku). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
